title: Show Me What You Don't Know: Efficient Sampling from Invariant Sets for Model Validation
abstract: arXiv:2603.21782v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The performance of machine learning models depends on discovering features in the data that are relevant to solving the given task while ignoring irrelevant variation. To check and visualize whether this is the case, we propose 'invariance auditing', a diagnostic tool to analyze feature extractors. Invariance auditing generates diverse inputs which all yield the same features as a given query input, and are therefore treated as identical by the model. Using external knowledge about the task at hand, this enables assessing if the learned invariances do or do not conform to the task's required semantics. Unlike existing work where a dedicated generative model is trained for each feature extractor, our algorithm is training-free and exploits a pretrained diffusion or flow-matching model to sample invariant inputs. translated_title: 让我看看你不知道什么：面向模型验证的不变集高效采样方法
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型的性能取决于发现数据中与解决给定任务相关的特征，同时忽略无关的变化。为了检查和可视化模型是否做到了这一点，我们提出了“不变性审计”，这是一种用于分析特征提取器的诊断工具。不变性审计会生成多样化的输入，这些输入都与给定的查询输入产生相同的特征，因此在模型看来它们是相同的。借助关于目标任务的外部知识，这使我们能够评估模型学习到的不变性是否符合任务所需的语义。与现有工作中需要为每个特征提取器专门训练一个生成模型不同，我们的算法无需训练，而是利用预训练的扩散模型或流匹配模型来采样不变输入。我们的纤维损失通过惩罚特征不匹配来引导去噪过程，使输出与查询输入共享相同的表示……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出免训练的“不变性审计”诊断工具，利用预训练的扩散或流匹配模型，通过纤维损失引导去噪过程，高效采样出与查询输入特征相同但形式多样的输入，从而检验模型学习到的不变性是否符合任务语义。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "invariance auditing", a training-free diagnostic tool that leverages a pretrained diffusion or flow-matching model with a fiber loss to efficiently sample diverse inputs yielding identical features as a query input, enabling validation of whether a model's learned invariances conform to the required task semantics.
